headline: MD resolves residue-specific and solvent control of biomolecular conformational states
label: Molecular Dynamics Sampling And Validation
summary: Simulated conformational ensembles are being scrutinized alongside new sampling, solvation and free energy benchmarks across disordered, RNA and folded protein…
synthesis: The common thread is atomistic and enhanced-sampling characterization of biomolecular conformational landscapes, solvation and interaction energetics. All-atom MD of spermine with Tau K18, α-synuclein and Aβ40 reports residue-specific rather than net-charge-driven control of aggregation-associated contacts. Microsecond simulations of viral TAR RNAs attribute solvation dynamics to intrinsic flexibility, base flipping, ions and TAT peptide binding. DASH combines deep learning with adaptive MD and seed selection to reach function-related metastable protein states, validated on 18 transitions. A benchmark of MM/PBSA, FEP and PMF methods addresses PARP1 versus PARP2 selectivity across eight clinical inhibitors, and well-tempered metadynamics of unbound MAX reveals a stable folded monomeric conformation. LLPSense extends the theme to condition-dependent phase separation prediction. What is new is the breadth of method comparison and residue-level resolution. The items do not establish a shared experimental calibration framework.
